description: MD Fit exercise library - Dr. Jared can edit this file to manage exercises

exercises.name: Cat Cow
cues: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
Inhale: drop belly, lift chest and tailbone (Cow)
Exhale: round spine, tuck chin and tailbone (Cat)
Move slowly with breath, 5-10 repetitions
modifications: Place blanket under knees if sensitive
Reduce range of motion if uncomfortable
exercises.safety_notes: Move within pain-free range. Stop if you experience sharp pain.

exercises.name: Eccentric Calf Drops
cues: Stand on edge of step with heels off
Rise up on toes using both legs
Shift weight to affected leg
Slowly lower heel below step level over 3-5 seconds
Use both legs to return to start position

default_prescription.stop_rules: Stop if pain exceeds 5/10 or sharp pain occurs

modifications: Use wall or rail for balance
Start with both legs if single leg is too difficult
Perform on flat ground first
exercises.safety_notes: This exercise may cause mild discomfort (3-4/10) which is acceptable. Stop if sharp pain occurs.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
cues: Start on hands and knees
Reach right arm under body, rotating torso
Let shoulder and head rest on ground
Hold 3-5 breaths, then rotate up reaching to ceiling
Repeat on other side
modifications: Place block or pillow under head
Reduce rotation range if uncomfortable

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
cues: Sit with legs in 90/90 position - both knees at 90 degrees
Front shin parallel to torso, back shin perpendicular
Lift both knees and switch sides smoothly
Keep spine tall throughout
Control the movement, don't rush
modifications: Sit on yoga block for elevation
Use hands behind you for support
Reduce knee angle if hip mobility limited
exercises.safety_notes: If you feel pinching in the front of hip, adjust position or reduce range.

exercises.name: Scalene Release
cues: Sit or stand tall with neutral spine
Tilt head away from tight side
Apply gentle overpressure with hand
Hold position and breathe
Release slowly after 30 seconds

default_prescription.stop_rules: Stop immediately if you experience dizziness, numbness, or tingling

modifications: Perform seated for stability
Use less pressure if sensitive
exercises.safety_notes: Gentle pressure only. Stop immediately if you experience dizziness, numbness, or tingling.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
cues: Stand tall, hold wall or chair if needed
Keep standing leg slightly bent
Lift working leg directly out to side
Keep toes pointing forward, not up
Control the return, don't swing
modifications: Add resistance band for progression
Use cable machine for resistance
Reduce range if hip clicking occurs

exercises.name: Thoracic Open Book
cues: Lie on side with knees bent 90 degrees
Stack knees and keep them together
Reach top arm forward, then rotate opening to ceiling
Follow hand with eyes
Let chest and shoulder relax toward floor
modifications: Place pillow between knees
Put pillow under bottom arm for comfort

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on back with arms reaching to ceiling
Lift legs to tabletop position (90 degree knees)
Press low back into floor throughout
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly
Return to start and alternate sides

coaching_cues: Keep low back pressed to floor

modifications: Keep knees bent more to reduce difficulty
Move only legs first, then add arms
Reduce range of motion
exercises.safety_notes: If low back arches off floor, reduce range of motion or regress the exercise.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand about 2 feet in front of bench
Place back foot on bench, laces down
Keep torso upright, core engaged
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Drive through front heel to stand
modifications: Use lower surface (step) for back foot
Hold wall or chair for balance
Add dumbbells for progression
exercises.safety_notes: Front knee should track over toes. Stop if sharp knee pain occurs.

exercises.name: Rotator Cuff Internal Rotation
cues: Stand with band anchored at elbow height
Keep elbow bent 90 degrees at side
Rotate forearm inward against resistance
Keep elbow pinned to side throughout
Control the return movement
modifications: Use towel roll between arm and body
Perform lying down if standing is difficult
Use lighter resistance band
exercises.safety_notes: Use light resistance. This should not cause pain.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand with feet hip-width apart, slight knee bend
Hold weights in front of thighs
Hinge at hips, pushing butt back
Lower weights along legs until stretch in hamstrings
Drive hips forward to return to standing
modifications: Perform single-leg version for stability challenge
Use kettlebell between legs
Perform without weight first to learn pattern
exercises.safety_notes: Keep back flat/neutral. Do not round spine during movement.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
cues: Start standing with feet together, arms at sides
Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead
Jump feet back together while lowering arms
Land softly on balls of feet
Maintain steady rhythm
modifications: Step out instead of jumping for low impact
Half jacks - arms only to shoulder height
Reduce speed if needed

exercises.name: Cable Rotation
cues: Stand perpendicular to cable machine
Hold handle with both hands at chest height
Rotate away from machine using core, not arms
Keep arms extended but not locked
Control the return, resist the pull
modifications: Use resistance band if no cable available
Perform half kneeling for more stability
Add anti-rotation hold at end range
exercises.safety_notes: Do not rotate through pain. Keep core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Plantar Fascia Release
cues: Sit with one ankle crossed over opposite knee
Pull toes back toward shin with hand
Use thumb to massage arch of foot
Apply firm but tolerable pressure
Work from heel to ball of foot

coaching_cues: Spend extra time on tender spots
Pressure should be firm but not sharp

modifications: Use tennis ball or frozen water bottle to roll
Perform standing on ball for more pressure
exercises.safety_notes: Mild discomfort is expected. Stop if sharp pain occurs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold weight at chest, elbows pointing down
Stand with feet slightly wider than hip width
Sit back and down, keeping chest tall
Lower until thighs parallel or below
Drive through whole foot to stand
modifications: Hold lighter weight or no weight
Box squat to target depth
Elevate heels for ankle mobility limitation
exercises.safety_notes: Knees should track over toes. Keep core braced throughout.
